tools.name: Model Vetting
tools.description: Compare IFs runfiles and inspect differences, charts, and trajectory audits. Included with Companion; install this package for independent tool updates.
tools.release_notes: Compare runfiles, inspect differences and trajectory audits, and export reports. Supports independent installation through Companion.

tools.name: Autotune
tools.description: Tune IFs through parameter experiments, inspect fit scores, and review optimization progress. Includes the Python and Electron runtimes.
tools.release_notes: Run parameter experiments, inspect fit scores, and review optimization progress inside Companion. Includes Python and Electron runtimes.

tools.name: Code Interpreter
tools.description: Explore IFs source code and wiki references with local text and semantic search, AI-assisted questions, and saved answers with citations.
tools.release_notes: Research IFs source and wiki references using local text and semantic search. Ask AI-assisted questions and save answers with citations. Includes source snapshots and an offline embedding model. Configure an AI provider in Companion for questions.

tools.name: Scenario Builder
tools.description: Turn a scenario description into an IFs scenario file. This tool is still planned.
